columns.name: waterway_flag
columns.reason: Fixed site characteristic of the crossing, recorded long before any inspection cycle.

columns.name: deck_condition_state
columns.reason: Deck condition is assessed by the same inspection that decides the rating, so it is not yet final.

columns.name: permit_class
columns.reason: Standing permit classification carried on the structure record.

columns.name: wetland_flag
columns.reason: Fixed environmental site attribute stored with the asset.

columns.name: superstructure_condition_state
columns.reason: Superstructure condition is a finding of the inspection that produces the rating decision.

columns.name: county_code
columns.reason: Permanent location attribute of the structure.

columns.name: paint_system
columns.reason: As-built and maintenance coating attribute already on the asset record.

columns.name: owner_agency
columns.reason: Standing ownership attribute of the bridge.

columns.name: nbi_submission_batch
columns.reason: Batch identifier is created when the completed inspection record is submitted, after the rating is set.

columns.name: material_type
columns.reason: Structural material fixed at construction.

columns.name: photo_vendor
columns.reason: Cannot tell whether the vendor is contracted in advance or only recorded when inspection photos are delivered.

columns.name: utility_attachment
columns.reason: Physical attachment held as a standing asset attribute.

columns.name: chloride_survey_index
columns.reason: Reads as a prior chloride survey result already on file for the structure.

columns.name: traffic_control_plan
columns.reason: A plan prepared before field work, so it exists once the inspection is scheduled.

columns.name: span_length_m
columns.reason: Fixed design geometry of the structure.

columns.name: route_class
columns.reason: Standing roadway classification for the carried route.

columns.name: historic_flag
columns.reason: Standing historic designation of the structure.

columns.name: drone_survey_flag
columns.reason: Unclear whether it marks a planned survey method or a record of what was actually flown.

columns.name: bearing_type
columns.reason: Fixed design detail of the structure.

columns.name: design_code
columns.reason: Code the bridge was designed to, fixed at construction.

columns.name: utility_owner
columns.reason: Standing attribute of the utility attached to the bridge.

columns.name: district
columns.reason: Permanent administrative location of the structure.

columns.name: load_posting_tonnes
columns.reason: Posted limit already of record, though a revised posting can follow a rating change.

columns.name: railing_type
columns.reason: Fixed design detail of the structure.

columns.name: followup_ndt_defect_index
columns.reason: Follow-up non-destructive testing is ordered because of the inspection findings, so it exists only afterward.

columns.name: adt_heavy_vehicles
columns.reason: Traffic statistic already recorded for the route.

columns.name: joint_type
columns.reason: Fixed design detail of the structure.

columns.name: access_equipment
columns.reason: Cannot tell whether it is the planned access method or the equipment actually used during the inspection.

columns.name: funding_program
columns.reason: Standing program the structure is funded and maintained under.

columns.name: seismic_zone
columns.reason: Fixed geographic design parameter of the site.

columns.name: substructure_condition_state
columns.reason: Substructure condition is a finding of the inspection that produces the rating decision.

columns.name: load_rating_method
columns.reason: Methodology of the load rating already on file for the structure.

columns.name: age_years
columns.reason: Derived from the build year and knowable at any prediction time.

columns.name: detour_designation
columns.reason: Standing detour designation held in the inventory record.

columns.name: consultant_firm
columns.reason: The firm is contracted and assigned before the inspection is carried out.

columns.name: detour_length_km
columns.reason: Standing inventory item describing the detour for the crossing.

columns.name: inspection_team
columns.reason: Team assignment is made when the inspection is scheduled, ahead of any findings.

columns.name: environmental_class
columns.reason: Standing exposure classification of the site.

columns.name: scour_class
columns.reason: Scour criticality rating already carried on the structure record.

columns.name: deicing_applications
columns.reason: Maintenance history accumulated before the prediction point.
